Checklists.title: Checklists
Checklists.body: A checklist walks you through a recurring job step by step, starting with the VAT period: from the open books to a filed, locked and paid return. Checks the system knows by itself fulfil themselves; steps only you can confirm carry your date and your name. Every step has a deadline, and whatever falls due appears in the attention hub. An agent walks the same list through the same verbs.

denied.read: You lack the read_books right, so no checklist is shown here.

error.transport: The checklists could not be loaded.

empty.title: No checklist yet
empty.hint: Start the VAT period for the last filing period that has ended. The steps and deadlines come by themselves.

missing.title: This checklist does not exist
missing.hint: The link points at no checklist in this workspace.

detail.done: Every step is done or not applicable.

note.stale: The return changed since the sign-off. Recompute it and sign off again.
note.preconditionOpen: The check {check} has to pass first.

check.no_drafts: No drafts up to the period end

item.no_drafts: No drafts up to the period end

start.title: Start a checklist
start.consequence: Creates the checklist with every step and deadline. A checklist is abandoned, never deleted.
start.needsConfig: Without VAT settings there are no filing periods.
start.notFilable: That is not a filing period of this year. Possible: {periods}

attest.title: Filed in the ESTV ePortal
attest.consequence: Marks the step as filed. The period is not locked by this.
attest.beforeExport: The date lies before the export on {exportedAt}.
attest.alreadyAttested: The filing is already attested on {date}. Reopen the step first.

skip.title: {item}: not applicable
skip.consequence: The step counts as not applicable and stays visible.

signoff.title: {item}
signoff.needsReference: Name the reference that proves the payment.
signoff.consequenceReview: Confirms the bridge for the return as computed now. If the return changes, the sign-off becomes void.
signoff.consequencePayment: Confirms that the payment or credit is booked. The reference stays on the step.

abandon.title: Abandon checklist {period}
abandon.consequence: The checklist stays visible and feeds no attention items any more. It is not deleted.
